name: Kasimir Oduya-Brandt
description: Three-time Ironwall Continental champion and the most decorated chrome-combat footballer in GLMZ history, Kasimir Oduya-Brandt plays striker for Spire Apex Lancers with a full-body titanium-ceramic skeletal overlay and a proprietary HelixCorp reaction-BCI suite that processes defensive formations 0.4 seconds faster than unaugmented cognition. Born to a Nigerian-Danish union in the Tier 3 Lakeshore stack, he clawed his way through the GRAVBALL feeder leagues before HelixCorp scouts pulled him at age nineteen. His signature 'Oduya Collapse' — a momentum-redirecting full-body tackle that has hospitalized eleven opponents — is legal in seven of eleven Meridian districts.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 investigative feed journalist obtains a partial copy of the suppressed HelixCorp audit and approaches Oduya-Brandt's estranged younger sister, who still lives in the Lakeshore stack, for corroboration.

A rival corponation's fixer is hired to sabotage Oduya-Brandt's chrome before the Continental final — but the saboteur discovers the augmentation contains something far more valuable than a sports advantage.

Oduya-Brandt quietly funds an underground youth Gravball league on the Shelf using cash accounts; when this leaks, both his corporate sponsors and the underground community react with fury for opposite reasons.
